## source_to_kb

### care_ext_late_pickup_fee_schedule
- Rule s1 (latest chargeable pickup; posted before any later; none -> nothing to price) -> late_pickup_fee_posting "Policy." verbatim-equivalent. Selection "latest by day of care" also in late_pickup_fee_calculation. Equivalent.
- Rule s2 = overwrite replaced_by (2026-27 by schedule; other years minutes x per-minute) -> late_pickup_fee_posting "Charge." Equivalent. Retired clause -> late_pickup_recording_warnings_and_dismissal "First incident." marked "no longer in force". The other base clauses stay in force there: grace, once per date, semesters, count includes waived, warning/dismissal, exclusions, no after-school session. Retired surface correct.
- Baseline rule (standard fee, minutes counted from close time, rounding) and the assembly sentence -> late_pickup_fee_calculation. Complete. The product figure (per-minute fee 1.00) is named "in the plan figures for late pickups" and found in late_pickup_recording_warnings_and_dismissal. Definite fall-back.
- Factor grade_band_minute_rate: 3 tiers incl. "no such record" -> late_pickup_rate_by_grade. Full, with figures 1.50 / 1.25 / 1.00. Names the product "Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions" and the record kind.
- Factor semester_repeat_multiplier: 3 tiers, compound condition intact ("issued before the service date"; "second or later chargeable") -> late_pickup_repeat_rate. Same-day-warning judgement = compute `<` (derivation).
- Factor minute_billing_convention (method): >30 quarter hours rounded up; <=10 minimum block 10; else as recorded -> late_pickup_minute_billing. Every tier and boundary (10/11, 30/31, 45/46) matches compute.
- Factor after_hours_charge: >=40 25.00; 20-39 10.00; <20 nothing -> after_hours_pickup_charge. Full.
- Tool contract (params, formats, owner agent, return, errors) -> late_pickup_fee_posting invocation block. Matches the task_tools body, including the cent-exact error.

### care_ext_booked_day_fee_schedule
- Rule s1 (most recent received/completed request by receipt time; declined/cancelled never priced; 2026-27 only; posted before the next request; none -> nothing; other years under the day-fee sentences) -> booked_day_fee_posting ¶1. Equivalent.
- Overwrites 1-3 replaced_by -> booked_day_fee_posting "Booking conditions". The bullets drop the apposition "which on an enrollment of the 2026-27 school year is the day rate the ... schedule starts from". That semantics is still entailed: booked_day_rate states that the 2026-27 fee "is the day rate of the requested date" and that "the part that sets the rate charged acts on the day rate first". So this is not an omission (see O-1). Overwrite 4 replaced_by -> booked_day_rate_by_meal_rate_basis "Clause". The four retired clauses -> booked_days_and_early_release "Clauses no longer in force". Active-only, booking gates, unused-day and closure credit stay in force there.
- Baseline (day rate by calendar class, rounding), order sentence and "no fee posts when no day rate" -> booked_day_rate, with the full 2026-27 calendars. The three day fees and early_release_included are named "in the plan figures for drop-in, holiday camp and early-release days" and found in booked_days_and_early_release.
- Factors rate_basis_day_rate (free flat 10.00 / reduced max(10.00, 75%) / other day rate), grade_band_day_supplement (6.00 / 4.00 / nothing incl. no record), plan_day_supplement (5.00 / 3.00 / nothing) and booking_lead_adjustment (>=14 -3.00 / <=6 +5.00 / else none) -> their four factor docs. Full, and the boundaries match compute `DAYS`.
- Tool contract -> booked_day_fee_posting invocation. Matches, including the day_type enum and the refusal of not_applicable.

### care_ext_current_year_payment_plan (root)
- Rule s1 (eligibility, family pays itself, desk never takes card details, posts to the enrollment) -> current_year_payment_plans "Terms".
- Suspension replaced_by -> same doc ¶2. Retired clause -> due_dates clause 4.
- Prerequisite H1 (state) "The first plan payment is not fixed until the enrollment's most recently recorded chargeable late pickup carries its late pickup fee entry." -> current_year_payment_plans, verbatim, connective "not fixed until" intact, and in no other doc. Basis: depended-on late_pickup_fee_posting "Posting books one late pickup fee entry on the enrollment's billing history for the day of care of that late pickup" + attendance log/ledger records.
- Prerequisite H2 (state) "...fixed only after the enrollment's most recently posted tuition charge carries its late payment fee entry whenever any part of that month's tuition was left unpaid on its due day." -> verbatim, same doc only. Basis: late_payment_fee_posting "One late payment fee entry is booked ... for that billing month" + ledger.
- Prerequisite H3 (state) "...fixed only after the enrollment's most recent drop-in booking request that is received or completed carries its booked-day fee entry whenever the booked day owes a fee." -> verbatim, same doc only. Basis: booked_day_fee_posting "Posting books one booked-day fee entry" + requests/ledger.
- Strength: hard gate in source and KB. condition / resolved_by / effect appear nowhere.
- Baseline (open balance definition, one payment, rounding, nothing when <= 0) and order sentence -> payment_plan_first_payment. The charge/reduction lists equal the compute event types.
- balance_payment_scale (4/3/2/1 at 300/150/50), semester_payment_limit (<=2 -> 2; 3-4 -> 3; >4 none; Dec/May last months, both ends included), plan_hardship_terms (free +2 / reduced +1 / else 0, effective on or before payment day), plan_returned_payment_rule (2/1/0, own enrollment, look-back sentence verbatim) and plan_payment_rule (fee-first / minimum below 50.00 / equal) -> five factor docs. Every tier full and matched to compute (open_window_cap 12 = "no limit", never binding since the scale is at most 4).
- Tool contract (owner user, hand-over, methods, return, errors) -> current_year_payment_plans invocation. Matches.

## bijection_verdict
**KB-BIJECTION: PASS.** Observations, none of them RED:
- O-1 booked_day_fee_posting "Booking conditions" drops the 2026-27 apposition of the three replaced_by sentences. It is entailed through booked_day_rate (day rate + order), so it is no omission. A reader of the hub alone sees "still charged the holiday camp day fee".
- O-2 late_pickup_repeat_rate example "The written warning is issued on that date" fixes a warning date in a hypothetical that the base leaves undated. It is consistent with base and has no scored effect (task 0's warning is dated 2026-11-11, after the pickup, under either reading).
- O-3 late_pickup_minute_billing boundary row "46 -> 60" uses the task's minutes figure. It is a natural boundary (45/46) in a full rule table and not a scored value.
- Look-back boundary days: the KB is faithful to the source wording and closes neither end. The underlying rule-vs-compute edge is source-side (SRC-1).

## dependency_form
- The three prerequisite sentences stand verbatim, in the state form, in the blocked hub only. No restatement names an action, a performer or a tool.
- No dependency table, checklist, route, ordered cross-problem step list, wrong-vs-right contrast or cross-problem FAQ anywhere in docs/care.
- Titles are general subjects ("Payment Plans for Current-Year Balances", "Posting the Late Pickup Fee", "Booked-Day Fees: Posting a Booked Day", "Late Payment Fee Posting Rules"). None mirrors this task's situation.
- Depended-on docs are reachable through the records' own words: "late pickup fee entry" (attendance log / billing history), "late payment fee entry" (billing month), "booked-day fee entry" (drop-in booking request).
- Computation docs carry their source assembly sentences, which A2 and the skill require there. They carry no "unless otherwise provided" or pointer, and no factor doc names the computation doc or another factor.
- Factor docs state ladders as rules. None says which tier a customer is on.

**KB-EXPLICIT: PASS**
